messages:
anya: heads up — after the slab compaction change on dedicated, we've seen a 7-12% p99 increase for Llama-13B serving when prefix cache hits are high. not consistent across models though.
milo: can you paste the perf profile?
anya: pasted a trimmed log below — main anomaly is longer memcpy in kv_copy and more kernel switches around step 0.
anya: ```
PROFILE: timeline
0.00s dispatch -> kernel_select(FP8_FALLBACK)
0.01s kv_copy (8MB)
0.03s kernel_launch matmul_v2_fp8
0.06s kernel_switch to fp16 path
```
devlin: interesting — slab compaction reduced fragmentation but changed placement for tail-chunks, which could trigger extra copies when kv pages cross slab boundaries.
kiran: could be alignment + RoPE table layout interacting — we saw similar for Mixtral where heads*kv_dim not page-aligned and prefetch goes to two slabs.
anya: confirmed: Llama config uses heads=32, kv_dim=128 => 4096 bytes per head row, but new allocator sometimes places them across 4k boundary.
jen: quick idea: add a fast-path that avoids memcpy when the src/dst are page-aligned and contiguous, and fallback to current copy otherwise.
milo: before changing code, can we try a runtime knob to prefer same-slab allocation for kv cache? i.e., allocator hint keyed by model+prefix-length.
devlin: we have that hint in branch 'allocator/same_slab_hint' — flips should be cheap to toggle per-node, worth trying on canary.
anya: started canary on 2 nodes with hint enabled for llama-13b. Initial numbers: p99 down 5%, avg unchanged. prefix-hit tail latency improved.
perf-bot: deploy-result: canary rollout completed on 2/2 nodes, no errors, CPU stable.
kiran: we still see occasional kernel selection oscillation: FP8 path -> fallback FP16 within same request. might be due to partial page copies delaying cache warm.
jen: is there a way to quantize kv in-place (lossy) for cold entries to avoid copying full fp16 blocks? we discussed low-bit quantized KV previously.
milo: prototype exists: 'kv-quant-lite' compresses trailing tokens to 8-bit with tiny linear dequant on access. quality regression small for 100-token contexts.
anya: can we gate kv-quant-lite to only non-prefetch cold pages? that reduces decode overhead when hot.
devlin: yes — policy: if last_access_ts > threshold -> keep fp16, else compress on eviction. need eviction hook to compress async.
kiran: profiler trace shows async compression increases background memcpy by 20ms but doesn't affect serving path if scheduled right.
milo: next steps: 1) roll same_slab_hint to more nodes 2) enable kv-quant-lite on a subset of traffic with eviction gating 3) add memcpy fast-path for aligned copies 4) add a tracing tag for 'split-slab-copy' to measure frequency.
anya: I'll open a PR for the aligned memcpy and tracing tag. Devlin, can you coordinate canary expansion for same_slab_hint?
devlin: on it, will also collect kernel_switch counts per-request.
jen: ping me when kv-quant-lite is enabled on canary; i'll run eval prompts for hallucination/regression.
anya: thanks — appreciate quick turnaround. filing follow-ups in the issue tracker. :thumbsup:
